_comment: OFFICE 1 — Preventive Las Vegas (ppclv1.fieldroutes.com). Edit these settings to control how price increases work for Office 1. Office 2 has its own file: office2_config.json

increase._type_options: Use 'percentage' for a % increase (e.g. 5 = 5%), or 'flat' for a flat dollar amount (e.g. 5 = add $5.00)
increase._value_note: For percentage: 5 means 5%. For flat: 5 means $5.00

eligibility._note: Only raise prices for customers who have NOT had an increase in this many days
eligibility._minimum_note: Only raise prices on subscriptions with a recurring charge at or above this amount
eligibility._service_types_note: Leave empty [] to include ALL service types, or list specific ones: ['General Pest', 'Mosquito', 'Termite']

notification._days_note: Send notice this many days before the price actually changes
notification._method_options: Use 'fieldroutes' for FieldRoutes built-in messaging, or 'podium' for Podium SMS
notification.email_subject: Important Notice: Upcoming Service Price Adjustment
notification.email_body:
Dear {customer_name},

We want to let you know that effective {effective_date}, your recurring service rate will be adjusted from ${old_price:.2f} to ${new_price:.2f} per service.

This adjustment reflects increased costs in labor, materials, and fuel. We remain committed to providing you with the best pest control service in the area.

If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to call us.

Thank you for your continued business!

{company_name}

account_notation.note_template: PRICE INCREASE: Recurring charge updated from ${old_price:.2f} to ${new_price:.2f} on {date}. Customer notified {days_before} days prior.

safety._dry_run_note: IMPORTANT: When true, the script shows what it WOULD do but makes NO changes. Set to false only when ready to run live.
safety._max_note: Safety limit — never process more than this many customers in one run. Increase if needed.
